resources.string: Where you type the pairing code while setting up the shell backend.
In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging, open it, and tap “Pair device with pairing code”. Keep that dialog open.
Found the pairing dialog. Tap “Enter code” here and type the 6-digit code it shows.
The pairing dialog isn\'t open. Tap “Pair device with pairing code” again, then enter the new code.
Done: WeiAssist\'s shell helper is running.
Paired, but the helper didn\'t start. Open WeiAssist → Settings → Shell backend and tap Start.
That code didn\'t work. Check the code in the dialog and try again (a new dialog shows a new code).
Wireless debugging is off (it turns off after a reboot or without Wi-Fi). Turn it on in Developer options, then tap Start.
The helper didn\'t report back. Try Start again.
